messages:
mike.sullivan: Quick pass to CS — Evergreen Biotech (trial, upsell potential). Sales notes below, high priority items and ask for CS + Support to triage.

mike.sullivan: Context: 30-seat trial started last week. Using hosted API for chat + embeddings. Main use-case: clinical summarization and triage routing. They plan pilot with 5 clinician teams.

mike.sullivan: Current signals: 5k tokens/day, several timeouts on long summaries, one data residency ask (EU only), SSO via Okta pending, and they asked about Dedicated later this year. Renewal window in 90 days.

mike.sullivan: Known risks: latency spikes on >1k token inputs, some hallucination concerns on structured outputs, and legal needs an export of data flow for HIPAA review.

mike.sullivan: Immediate asks: 1) CS to own onboarding and Okta SSO setup 2) Support to triage timeouts & recommend model/config 3) Eng to advise on EU data residency options + Dedicated timeline.

mike.sullivan: Links: onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/evergreen, trial dashboard: https://console.redwood/evergreen (read-only for now).

ashley.cho: Thanks Mike — picking this up. Quick checklist from CS side: SSO owner, onboarding sessions, custom prompt templates, success metrics. I’ll schedule kickoff with their PM.

ashley.cho: For SSO: do we have their Okta metadata? Mike, can you share idp metadata and SCIM expectation?

mike.sullivan: Sent idp metadata to ashley and legal via email. SCIM: they prefer SCIM but can start without for pilot.

ashley.cho: Noted. I'll request a 60-minute kickoff next Tue. Owner: ashley.cho. Deadline: confirm SSO setup or rollback plan within 7 business days.

rana.khan: Support triage here. Can you paste a sample of the long summary request that timed out? Also what model/version are they hitting?

mike.sullivan: Sample posted to the shared drive: /shared/evergreen/timeout_sample.txt. They are on model redwood-2-medium-prod via hosted endpoint. Timeouts occur around 90s mark for ~1.5k token generation.

rana.khan: Got it. I'll reproduce on staging and check batching/timeout config. Likely either request size or backend kernel fallback. Assigning myself to triage. ETA first repro by EOD tomorrow.

tom.lee: From Eng (runtime): we saw a 10% increase in tail latency for that tenant due to long-context combos. Short-term options: 1) increase request timeout for them (risky), 2) configure streaming + chunked summaries, 3) recommend quantized model variant with lower latency. Long-term: Dedicated or EU-region deployment. I can run a perf profile if you provide the sample.

tom.lee: Also, exporting logs for HIPAA review — we can produce an architecture summary and data flow doc. Need owner from legal/compliance, but Eng can produce technical artifact.

ashley.cho: Action items I'm taking: - Schedule kickoff (owner: ashley) - Confirm Okta metadata and SCIM preference (owner: ashley) - Prepare success metrics template for their pilot (owner: ashley) - Coordinate legal intake for HIPAA/data flow (owner: ashley -> legal team)

rana.khan: Support action items: - Reproduce timeout locally (owner: rana) - Share workaround (streaming/chunking) and config patch for client SDK (owner: rana) - If root cause is model kernel, escalate to tom (owner: rana -> tom).

tom.lee: Eng action items: - Perf profile for sample (owner: tom) - Outline Dedicated/EU options and ETA (owner: tom) - Produce data flow & logs export template for compliance (owner: tom)

enablement-bot: Reminder: Please add meeting calendar invites and set "Onboarding Kickoff" template.

mike.sullivan: Customer notes re: renewal — economic committee review in ~60 days, pilot success required to push to procurement. They’re price-sensitive but value low latency and data isolation.

ashley.cho: Flagging renewal risk: Medium-high. Will add checkpoint at 30 days post-kickoff to evaluate adoption signals (active users, avg latency, accuracy).

mike.sullivan: Intro email to customer has been sent; I'll join the kickoff too.

rana.khan: After I reproduce timeout I'll post minimal repro steps and suggested SDK snippet:```js
// recommended chunked streaming + backoff
const resp = await Redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-2-medium-prod',
  input: longPrompt,
  stream: true,
  chunk_size: 512,
  max_tokens: 800
});
```

ashley.cho: Nice. I'll include that workaround in onboarding guide in case we need to ship quickly.

tom.lee: One more thing — for EU-only requirement we can offer Private VPC in eu-west-1 or Dedicated pool in Q3. Timeline estimate: 6-8 weeks for Private setup (legal + infra), 4-6 weeks for Dedicated sizing + provisioning. I'll draft options doc.

mike.sullivan: Thanks everyone. Quick summary and owners: Kickoff (ashley) in 3 days, Support triage (rana) repro by EOD tomorrow, Eng perf profile (tom) by 3 business days, Compliance artifact (tom) by 5 days. I'll update the sales record with owners.

ashley.cho: I'll post an update thread after kickoff with next steps and a 30-day adoption checkpoint. :thumbsup:

rana.khan: Adding a support ticket for Evergreen: ticket #SUP-5123. I'll link it when repro steps are ready.

mike.sullivan: Appreciate it — closing the loop here.

ashley.cho: Thanks — looping in legal and enablement now.
